## Learning Objectives

- Explain the concept of power and its role in detecting meaningful effects in a study.
- Describe how variability, sample size, and design choices influence the power of the F-test.
- Use software tools to compute power and determine required sample sizes for different experimental designs.
 

:::

- If you want more or a different modality, read [Oehlert Ch 7](_text/oehlert_ch7.pdf).
